message:
Let me check if htslib is already built and if there's a fuzzer binary:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib/*.a /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib/*.so 2>/dev/null; ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib/test/fuzz/ 2>/dev/null; find /workspace -name "hts_open_fuzzer*" -type f 2>/dev/null</｜｜DSML｜｜>
